remarks: GREAT VALUE AND NO CONDO FEES EVER !!!! Welcome to the all-new Hillcrests model by award-winning Pacesetter Homes, located in the desirable community of Copperhaven.  This thoughtfully designed bi-level town home is the perfect home for growing families, offering a bright and functional open-concept main floor. The spacious kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining area and great room, creating an ideal space for everyday living and entertaining. The private primary bedroom is conveniently located on the main level, providing a peaceful retreat. The fully finished lower level features two additional spacious bedrooms, a large family room, and a full bathroom, offering plenty of space for children, guests, or a home office. Situated in the heart of Copperhaven this beautiful home is just steps from two schools, scenic walking trails, and nearby amenities, shopping, and major commuter routes.  *** This home is under construction and will be complete in February of 2027 *** (id:67522)
